manuscript.title: Gold: Our bearish plan, 3954–3964 entry, 4004 invalidation.

summary.fear: We see failed talks and buying by bearish investors as reasons gold could rebound.
summary.invalidation: We reject entry after a completed 15-minute close above 3972.6; afterward, our invalidation is 4004.
summary.macro: We account for euro area growth during the window and finish before United States producer inflation.
summary.plan: We tie our bearish plan to 3954–3964, explicit invalidation and the supplied deadlines.
summary.positioning: We retain buying by investors closing bearish bets as a reversal mechanism without claiming those holdings are crowded.
summary.priced_in: We see repricing already underway, tempered by the extent of the decline and unresolved talks.
summary.scenarios: We retain Main at 55% and leave the supplied rebound alternative unquantified.
summary.story: We retain the bearish explanation while acknowledging that the supplied historical review did not establish a dependable advantage.
summary.technical: We favor a bearish view near 3954–3964, while recognizing that the lower range could obstruct further declines.
